title: Seagrove "Time Well Spent" 109 Santa Clara Street
h1: Seagrove "Time Well Spent" 109 Santa Clara Street
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS- 3-minute walk or less to beach- Santa Clara access is ADA accessible via ramp and has parking, restrooms, and lifeguards during peak season- Private pool**Pool heating available October 1-May 1 for $35 per day** - 2-minute drive to Publix in WaterColor Shopping Center- Short bike ride to Seaside or favorite local restaurants, Cafe 30A, Surfing Deer, and Market Cafe- Game room featuring PacMan machine, Atari games, & foosball Table- 2 Refrigerators and 2 dishwashers- 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle- 6 adult bikes provided- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, laundered upon every checkoutGOURMET KITCHEN: Spacious enough for multiple guests to cook at once, this kitchen is more than fully equipped for your next vacation. Style meets function with quartz countertops, soft-close cabinets, and double dishwashers. Large groups will find all they need for meals or snacks, including both a standard coffee maker and a Keurig, a walk-in pantry, and plenty of serving dishes, glasses, utensils, and cooking tools. A large dining table seats eight comfortably, and the huge center island with four bar stools offer additional seating and plenty of counter space for buffet-style family meals. If you prefer to dine al fresco, there is even more seating for ten on the back deck overlooking the pool. Roomy and well-equipped, the kitchen at Time Well Spent is perfectly designed for large groups to eat and enjoy time together.BEACH ACCESS:Take a short 2-3 minute stroll across 30A, and you'll find yourself at one of the best beach access locations along Hwy 30A. The Santa Clara beach access has ample parking for cars, Low-Speed Vehicles, and bikes, as well as clean restrooms and a lifeguard stand. BUNK AND GAME ROOM:The game room, featuring refreshed furniture and located on the third floor, is a fun space for kids and adults to play and enjoy time together. It's furnished with two full-size custom built-in bunk beds, which will be a favorite with the kids, teens, and maybe even some select adults. An arcade game room with a foosball table and 75-inch flat-screen smart TV, with a Blu-ray player and a family-friendly movie library, make this a great space to hang out. It's the perfect spot for a movie marathon or to watch a ball game on the oversized sectional sofa.BEDROOMS: Every bedroom in Time Well Spent is a relaxing retreat for guests. For restful nights, each bed is outfitted with a pillow-top mattress and cozy bedding that will tempt you to head to bed early each night and sleep in every morning. Five bedrooms have king-size beds, and all guest rooms have 40-inch Smart TVs and closets for stowing away your luggage. In addition to the king bed, each of the two primary bedrooms has a twin-size built-in bunk for toddlers. SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 20):FIRST FLOOR- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Tub/Shower ComboSECOND FLOOR- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with ShowerTHIRD FLOOR- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed, Private Bath- Game Room Bunks: Two Full over Full Built-in Bunk beds
